newsitem.title: EU: COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY - TUESDAY MARCH 18-THURSDAY MARCH 20.
newsitem.headline: COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY - TUESDAY MARCH 18-THURSDAY MARCH 20.

text.p: COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-282/95 P Guerin automobiles v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against Court judgment (third chamber enlarged), rendered June 27, 1995, in case T-186/94, Guerin Automobiles v/ Commission. Judgment finding insufficient grounds to judge an action for incompetence and rejecting as inadmissible the subsidiary conclusions in annulment. - Judgment C-343/95 Diego Cali e Figli: competition. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 86. Companies to which member states grant special or exclusive rights. Company charged by Genoa port authorities to render a pollution-related service to all vessels discharging or charging oil or petrochemical products. Service not desired and remunerated according to a fixed tariff. - Oral procedure C-20/96 Snares: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 4, paragraph 2(a) and 10(a) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Disability living allowance. Exclusion since June 1, 1992, from the meaning of article 4, paragraph 1 of regulation 1408/71.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0915/0815 GMT) - Judgment T-73/95 Oliveira v/ Commission: social policy. Partial annulment of Commission decision of December 28, 1994, reducing the financial contribution initially granted by the European Social Fund for training programmes, following court annulment (judgment of May 7, 1991) of a first decision to reduce the Fund's financial contribution.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-24/95 Alcan Deutschland: state aid. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EU law on state aid. EC treaty articles 92 and 93, paragraph 3. Obligation to recuperate an illegal aid. Difficulties resulting from national rules protecting the beneficiary of the aid. Exception to condictio indebiti. - Judgment C-57/95 France v/ Commission: company law. Annulment of Commission communication 94/C 360/08 on an internal market for pension funds. Freedom to manage and invest funds collected by pension institutions. - Opinion joined cases C-37/96, C-38/96 Sodiprem: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 95. New arrangements on dock dues as applied in French overseas departments. - Opinion C-54/96 Dorsch Consult: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article I, paragraph 1 of Council directive 89/665 of December 21, 1989, on the coordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions relating to the application of review procedures to the award of public supply and public works contracts, as amended by article 41 of Council directive 92/50/EEC of June 18, 1992, coordinating procedures in the award of public supply contracts. Determination of the national instance responsible for examining appeals provided for in directive 92/50/EEC in the absence of an national act of transposition. - Opinion C-212/96 Chevassus-Marche: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity and interpretation of Council directive 89/688/EEC of December 22, 1989, on arrangements on dock dues in French overseas departments. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9, 12, 13 and 92. Regulatory measures that allow an exemption in favour of local companies of said departments, on the condition that these companies contribute to the development or maintenance of an economic activity. - Opinion C-392/95 Parliament v/ Council: approximation of legislation. Annulment of Council regulation 2317/95 of September 25, 1995, determining from which third countries citizens are required to have a visa when crossing the external borders of member states. Obligation to re-consult the European Parliament under article 100 C of the EC treaty following a substantial modification of the Commission proposition.

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-201/96 LTM: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council regulation 1010/86 of March 25, 1986, laying down general rules on production refunds for certain sugar sector products for use in the chemical industry. Interpretation of chapters 21 and 30 of the Common Customs and Excise Tariff. Tariffs on products "ALVITYL 50 dragees" and "STRONGENOL 20 Ampoules".

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-13/96 Bic Benelux: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, points 1 and 5 of Council directive 83/189/EEC of March 28, 1983, on a procedure for the provision of information in the field of technical standards and regulations, as amended by Council directive 88/182/EEC of March 22, 1988. Notions of "technical specifications" and "technical rules". Distinctive mark, indicating either that a product is subject to an ecotax, and for what amount; or the cause of its exemption; or the amount of the deposit on it. - Judgment C-96/95 Commission v/ Germany: free movement of persons. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 90/362/EEC of June 28, 1990, on the right of stay and of 90/365/EEC on the right of stay of salaried and non salaried workers who have ceased their professional activity. - Judgment C-294/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 93/42/EEC of June 14, 1993, on medical devices. - Judgment C-352/95 Phytheron International: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Parallel imports of a phytosanitary product of extra-Community origin, approved and protected by an identical trademark in the two members states concerned. Reuter European Court of Justice Diary (page 2/2) - Opinion C-45/96 Bayerische Hypotheken-und Wechselbank: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 1 of Council directive 85/577/EEC of December 20, 1985, on the protection of consumers in cases of contracts outside commercial establishments. Notion of "consumer". A security contract under German law, subscribes by an individual acting on his own behalf, to guarantee a bank credit accorded to a third party. - Opinion C-90/96 Petrie: free movement of persons. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 5 an 48 and of articles 1 and 3 of Council regulation 1612/68, of October 15, 1968, on freedom of movement for workers within the Community. Access to the job of substitute teacher in universities. Accredited professors and confirmed university researchers. Exclusion of foreign language assistants. - Opinion C-107/96 Commission v/ Spain: environment and consumers. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/156/EEC of March 18, 1991, amending Council directive 75/442/EEC on waste. - Opinion C-223/96 Commission v/ France: environment and consumers. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/156/EEC of March 18, 1991, amending Council directive 75/442/EEC on waste. - Opinion joined cases C-286/94, C-340/95, C-401/95, C-47/96 Garage Molenheide: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 18, paragraph 4 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. National law allowing a seizure of goods against the sum due a VAT administration in cases of suspected tax fraud. - Opinion C-389/95 Klattner: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 83/182/EEC of March 28, 1983, on tax exemption applicable inside the EU on temporary imports of certain means of transport. Possibility for national authorities to limit the number of vehicles benefiting from the exemption. Principle of proportionality. Sanctions in case of breach. - Oral procedure C-366/95 Steff-Houlberg Export: community resources. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EU law as regards national rules on "condictio indebiti" as applicable, in the absence of specific EU rules, to repeated export repayments unduly paid out.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-295/95 Farrell: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 5, paragraph 2 of Brussels Convention. Maintenance. Maintenance creditor. Claiming party unable to take advantage of a previous court decision recognising a right to maintenance at the expense of the defending party. - Judgment C-323/95 Hayes: principles of Community law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 7. National law requiring foreigners appearing in court to pay a "cautio judicature solvi". - Opinion C-60/96 Commission v/ France: taxation. Non respect. Violation of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Granting of a VAT exemption on the rental of certain furnished goods such as tents, caravans and mobile homes. - Opinion C-144/96 Cirotti: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 46 and 51 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. National law granting to a separated spouse a percentage of her husband's retirement pension. - Opinion C-259/95 Parliament v/ Council: environment and consumers. Annulment of Council decision 95/184 of May 22, 1995, amending decision 3092/94 on the institution of a Community information system on domestic and recreational accidents. Unilateral amendment by the Council on the basis of article 169 of the Membership Act of 1994 of a decision taken by the European Parliament and the Council under the procedure of EC treaty article 189B ("codecision). - Opinion C-279/94 Commission v/ Italy: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Article 8 paragraph 1 and 9 of Council directive 83/189/EEC of March 28, 1983, on a procedure for the provision of information in the field of technical standards and regulations. Adoption of law no. 257 of March 27, 1992, on the cessation of the use of asbestos. Absence of prior Commission notification. - Opinion C-283/95 Fischer: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 11A, paragraph 1 (a) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Application to an illicit games of chance organisation. Roulette. Total takings or difference between chips sold and reimbursed. - Opinion C-357/96 Commission v/ Belgium: environment and consumers. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Commission directive 94/15/EEC of April 15, 1994, adapting to technical advances the directive adopting for the first time Council directive 90/220/EEC on the wilful dissemination of genetically modified organisms into the environment. - Oral procedure C-122/96 Saldanha: principles of Community law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6, paragraph 1 of EC treaty. National law requiring foreign claimants to provide a "cautio judicature solvi" as provided for in cases of action instituted by a foreign individual or judicial entity. Claimant possessing two nationalities, one of which is a of a non-member state.
